IS 1559 : Part 3 : 2025 Methods of Chemical Analysis of Ferrosilicon - Part 3 Determination of Sulphur
ICS 77.100
ICS 77.100
MTD 34
MTD 34
1 SCOPE
This standard (Part 3) covers the determination of sulphur (up to 0.050 percent) in ferrosilicon.
2 REFERENCES
The standards given below contains provisions, which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid.
